mainEntity.name: What defines a luxury backyard design?

acceptedAnswer.text: A luxury backyard design extends your living space outdoors with high-end features and sophisticated aesthetics. This often includes custom swimming pools, integrated outdoor kitchens, elegant landscaping, premium hardscaping materials, and dedicated entertainment zones. The focus is on creating a cohesive, functional, and visually stunning environment that complements your home's architecture and lifestyle, often incorporating advanced technology for lighting, audio, and climate control.
acceptedAnswer.description: Luxury backyard design creates sophisticated outdoor living spaces with high-end features like custom pools, outdoor kitchens, and elegant landscaping, tailored to your home and lifestyle.
